id-20260912-news-2.title: Indonesia's Palm Oil Exports to the EU Held Back by the Shadow of EUDR, Far Behind China

segments.src: Industri kelapa sawit nasional kembali dihadapkan pada tantangan besar di pasar ekspor utama.
segments.tr: The national palm oil industry is once again facing major challenges in key export markets.

segments.src: Volume pengiriman minyak sawit mentah atau crude palm oil (CPO) Indonesia ke Uni Eropa tercatat tertahan di kisaran 3,2 juta ton, jauh tertinggal dibandingkan volume ekspor ke China yang mencapai 5,9 juta ton.
segments.tr: Indonesia's shipments of crude palm oil (CPO) to the European Union have been recorded to stall at around 3.2 million tons, falling far behind export volumes to China, which reached 5.9 million tons.

segments.src: Kesenjangan ini mencerminkan pergeseran arah perdagangan sawit nasional seiring meningkatnya tekanan regulasi di pasar Eropa.
segments.tr: This gap reflects a shift in the direction of national palm oil trade alongside increasing regulatory pressure in the European market.

segments.src: ## Bayang-Bayang Regulasi Antideforestasi Uni Eropa
segments.tr: ## The Shadow of the European Union Deforestation Regulation

segments.src: Salah satu faktor yang banyak disorot pelaku usaha adalah rencana penerapan penuh European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR), regulasi yang mewajibkan produk pertanian termasuk sawit untuk dibuktikan bebas dari praktik deforestasi sejak akhir 2020.
segments.tr: One of the factors heavily highlighted by business players is the planned full implementation of the European Union Deforestation Regulation (EUDR), a regulation requiring agricultural products including palm oil to be proven free from deforestation practices since late 2020.

segments.src: Aturan ini menuntut sistem keterlacakan (traceability) yang detail hingga ke titik koordinat lahan, sesuatu yang dinilai berat khususnya bagi petani sawit swadaya yang mengelola lahan dalam skala kecil dan tersebar.
segments.tr: This rule demands a detailed traceability system down to land coordinate points, something considered burdensome, especially for independent smallholder palm oil farmers who manage small-scale and scattered plots.

segments.src: Ketidakpastian soal jadwal serta mekanisme teknis pelaksanaan EUDR membuat sebagian eksportir dan pembeli di Eropa bersikap lebih hati-hati dalam menjalin kontrak jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Uncertainty regarding the schedule and technical implementation mechanism of the EUDR has caused some exporters and buyers in Europe to be more cautious in establishing long-term contracts.

segments.src: Kondisi ini turut mendorong pelaku industri mengalihkan sebagian volume penjualan ke pasar alternatif yang dinilai memiliki persyaratan lebih fleksibel, salah satunya China.
segments.tr: This condition has also prompted industry players to divert some sales volumes to alternative markets deemed to have more flexible requirements, one of which is China.

segments.src: ## China Jadi Tujuan Ekspor Andalan
segments.tr: ## China Becomes a Mainstay Export Destination

segments.src: Berbeda dengan Uni Eropa, permintaan dari China terhadap CPO Indonesia relatif stabil dan cenderung meningkat.
segments.tr: Unlike the European Union, demand from China for Indonesia's CPO is relatively stable and tends to increase.

segments.src: Kebutuhan minyak nabati untuk konsumsi pangan maupun industri di China menjadi salah satu pendorong utama tingginya volume serapan tersebut.
segments.tr: The need for vegetable oil for both food consumption and industrial use in China is one of the main drivers of this high absorption volume.

segments.src: Selisih hampir dua kali lipat antara ekspor ke China dan Uni Eropa ini menegaskan bahwa peta permintaan global terhadap sawit Indonesia tengah bergeser dari pasar tradisional Barat menuju kawasan Asia.
segments.tr: The nearly twofold difference between exports to China and the European Union emphasizes that the global demand map for Indonesian palm oil is shifting from traditional Western markets toward the Asian region.

segments.src: ## Percepatan Sertifikasi ISPO dan Penguatan Rantai Pasok
segments.tr: ## Acceleration of ISPO Certification and Supply Chain Strengthening

segments.src: Menghadapi tantangan tersebut, pelaku industri sawit dalam negeri disebut tengah mempercepat proses sertifikasi Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO) sekaligus memperkuat sistem keterlacakan rantai pasok dari kebun hingga pabrik pengolahan.
segments.tr: Facing these challenges, domestic palm oil industry players are reportedly accelerating the Indonesian Sustainable Palm Oil (ISPO) certification process while strengthening supply chain traceability systems from plantations to processing mills.

segments.src: Langkah ini dipandang penting bukan hanya untuk memenuhi standar keberlanjutan yang diminta pasar Eropa, tetapi juga untuk menjaga daya saing sawit nasional di tengah ketatnya persaingan minyak nabati global.
segments.tr: This step is seen as important not only to meet the sustainability standards demanded by the European market, but also to maintain the competitiveness of national palm oil amid tight global vegetable oil competition.

segments.src: Beberapa asosiasi dan pemangku kepentingan di sektor sawit juga mendorong digitalisasi data perkebunan, termasuk pemetaan lahan berbasis geospasial, agar proses verifikasi kepatuhan terhadap EUDR dapat berjalan lebih efisien.
segments.tr: Several associations and stakeholders in the palm oil sector are also encouraging the digitalization of plantation data, including geospatial-based land mapping, so that the verification process for EUDR compliance can run more efficiently.

segments.src: Dukungan terhadap petani swadaya melalui program legalitas lahan dan pendampingan teknis turut menjadi perhatian, mengingat kelompok ini menyumbang porsi signifikan dari total produksi sawit nasional.
segments.tr: Support for independent smallholders through land legality programs and technical assistance is also a point of attention, given that this group accounts for a significant portion of total national palm oil production.

segments.src: ## Tantangan sekaligus Peluang ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Challenges as Well as Future Opportunities

segments.src: Meski volume ekspor ke Uni Eropa belum kembali ke level sebelumnya, sejumlah pelaku usaha meyakini bahwa penguatan tata kelola dan sertifikasi justru dapat menjadi modal penting bagi keberlanjutan industri sawit dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Although export volumes to the European Union have not returned to previous levels, a number of business players believe that strengthening governance and certification can actually be an important asset for the long-term sustainability of the palm oil industry.

segments.src: Kepatuhan terhadap standar internasional dinilai dapat membuka akses ke pasar-pasar baru yang juga mulai menerapkan persyaratan keberlanjutan serupa.
segments.tr: Compliance with international standards is considered capable of opening access to new markets that are also beginning to implement similar sustainability requirements.

segments.src: Ke depan, arah kebijakan pemerintah dan respons pelaku industri terhadap pemberlakuan penuh EUDR akan menjadi penentu apakah pangsa pasar sawit Indonesia di Uni Eropa dapat kembali pulih, atau justru semakin bergantung pada permintaan dari mitra dagang Asia seperti China.
segments.tr: Going forward, the direction of government policy and the response of industry players to the full enforcement of the EUDR will determine whether Indonesia's palm oil market share in the European Union can recover, or instead become increasingly dependent on demand from Asian trading partners such as China.

id-20260912-news-3.title: Cooking Oil and Granulated Sugar Prices Drop Together in Early September, Government Continues to Monitor HET

segments.src: Memasuki awal September, harga dua komoditas pangan strategis yakni minyak goreng curah dan gula pasir lokal menunjukkan tren penurunan di sejumlah pasar tradisional.
segments.tr: Entering early September, the prices of two strategic food commodities, namely bulk cooking oil and local granulated sugar, have shown a downward trend in a number of traditional markets.

segments.src: Kondisi ini disambut positif oleh masyarakat, terutama menjelang aktivitas ekonomi rumah tangga yang kembali normal setelah periode permintaan tinggi beberapa waktu sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This condition is welcomed positively by the community, especially ahead of household economic activities that are returning to normal after a period of high demand some time ago.

segments.src: ## Rincian Penurunan Harga
segments.tr: ## Price Drop Details

segments.src: Berdasarkan pemantauan harga di pasar, minyak goreng curah tercatat turun dari sebelumnya sekitar Rp21.250 per kilogram menjadi kisaran Rp20.450 per kilogram.
segments.tr: Based on price monitoring in the market, bulk cooking oil was recorded to have dropped from around Rp21.250 per kilogram to a range of Rp20.450 per kilogram.

segments.src: Sementara itu, harga gula pasir lokal juga melandai ke level sekitar Rp19.100 per kilogram.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the price of local granulated sugar also eased to a level of around Rp19.100 per kilogram.

segments.src: Penurunan harga kedua komoditas ini diperkirakan dipengaruhi oleh sejumlah faktor, termasuk pasokan yang lebih stabil di tingkat distributor serta membaiknya arus distribusi dari sentra produksi ke pasar-pasar daerah.
segments.tr: The price decline of these two commodities is estimated to be influenced by a number of factors, including more stable supply at the distributor level and improved distribution flow from production centers to regional markets.

segments.src: Meski demikian, sejumlah pedagang menyebut harga masih dapat berfluktuasi mengikuti dinamika pasokan bahan baku dan biaya distribusi.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, a number of traders mentioned that prices could still fluctuate following the dynamics of raw material supply and distribution costs.

segments.src: ## Pemerintah Tegaskan Pengawasan HET
segments.tr: ## Government Emphasizes HET Supervision

segments.src: Di tengah tren penurunan harga ini, Kementerian Pertanian menegaskan bahwa pengawasan terhadap Harga Eceran Tertinggi (HET) tetap menjadi prioritas.
segments.tr: Amid this downward price trend, the Ministry of Agriculture emphasized that supervision of the Highest Retail Price (HET) remains a priority.

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan akan menindak tegas pelaku usaha atau pedagang yang terbukti menjual komoditas pangan di atas ketentuan HET yang berlaku.
segments.tr: The government stated that it will take firm action against business actors or traders proven to be selling food commodities above the applicable HET provisions.

segments.src: Langkah pengawasan ini dilakukan untuk memastikan penurunan harga yang terjadi benar-benar dirasakan oleh konsumen akhir, bukan hanya berhenti di tingkat distributor besar.
segments.tr: This supervision step is taken to ensure that the price decline that is occurring is truly felt by end consumers, not just stopping at the large distributor level.

segments.src: Instansi terkait juga disebut akan terus melakukan pemantauan berkala di pasar-pasar tradisional maupun modern guna menjaga kestabilan harga menjelang periode-periode permintaan tinggi berikutnya.
segments.tr: Relevant agencies are also said to continue conducting periodic monitoring in traditional and modern markets to maintain price stability ahead of the next high-demand periods.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Konsumen dan Pelaku Usaha
segments.tr: ## Impact on Consumers and Business Actors

segments.src: Penurunan harga minyak goreng dan gula pasir tentu memberi sedikit ruang bernapas bagi rumah tangga, khususnya pelaku usaha kecil di sektor kuliner yang sangat bergantung pada kedua bahan pokok tersebut.
segments.tr: The decline in cooking oil and granulated sugar prices certainly provides a little breathing room for households, especially small business actors in the culinary sector who are highly dependent on these two staple foods.

segments.src: Namun, para pengamat ekonomi mengingatkan bahwa stabilitas harga jangka panjang tetap bergantung pada kelancaran rantai pasok, ketersediaan bahan baku, serta kebijakan harga acuan yang konsisten dari pemerintah.
segments.tr: However, economic observers remind that long-term price stability still depends on the smoothness of the supply chain, the availability of raw materials, and consistent reference price policies from the government.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk terus memantau perkembangan harga melalui kanal resmi pemerintah daerah maupun kementerian terkait, sekaligus melaporkan apabila menemukan indikasi penjualan di atas HET di lapangan.
segments.tr: The public is urged to continue monitoring price developments through official channels of local governments or relevant ministries, as well as to report if they find indications of sales above the HET in the field.

segments.src: Dengan pengawasan yang konsisten, diharapkan tren positif penurunan harga ini dapat bertahan dan memberi manfaat nyata bagi daya beli masyarakat.
segments.tr: With consistent supervision, it is hoped that this positive trend of price decline can be maintained and provide real benefits for people's purchasing power.
